page.notes: The right-hand part of the page is cut off, so the entries are read only to the cut edge. Several page numbers are blurred and printed in old figures (e.g. 183, 121, 111, 86), so some numbers may be misread. The entry "diu Senex[?]" is unclear. Where the scan shows the long s, it is given as s; the spelling of some words such as "viuiscit" is uncertain.
